headline: Daily research brief — Friday, November 6

items.title: Nvidia reports Nov 17, and options price a ±6.2% move
items.detail: Nvidia is the only watchlist name reporting in the next two weeks, Tue Nov 17 after close, with Nasdaq consensus EPS of $2.49. The desk's variance-decomposition estimate of the earnings-day move is ±6.2%, cross-checked against ApexVol at ±6.1%; the 10-year average realized move is ±8.4% and the 2-year average ±5.7%, so options price a bigger-than-recent but smaller-than-historical event. The stock closed at $186.64, about 23% below its $243.37 high and about 15% below its 50-day average. The Nov 20 expiry implied volatility of 0.694 versus 0.572 at Nov 13 prices the event; premium sold into the print is premium into a binary event: avoid.

items.title: Crude fell about 13% on the week as the midterm result repriced war premium lower
items.detail: Brent settled Fri at $98.32 and WTI at $90.83, the biggest weekly percentage drop since 2022, after Democrats regained the House and Senate and the market raised the odds of a negotiated de-escalation with Iran. Fresh Hormuz tanker attacks on Nov 5-6 put a floor under the fall, and one seafarer was killed Thu. The physical market is tighter than the price fall suggests: distillates drew 3.6 million barrels to 99.3 million, the lowest since May 2003 and 13% below the five-year average, while Brent swaps flipped to contango. Next clearing events: USDA WASDE and the EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook Tue Nov 10, and the EIA petroleum report Thu Nov 12.

items.title: No clean premium verdict on Apple or Microsoft — both are window-contingent
items.detail: A single day drives 55.5% of Apple's and 49.9% of Microsoft's 20-day realized variance, so the implied-versus-realized comparison is not meaningful on either name until the jump ages out. Live post-close implied volatility: SPY 0.157 and QQQ 0.231 at the Nov 9 expiry, roughly at or modestly above trailing 20-day realized volatility. Nvidia (0.436) and Tesla (0.424) front implied volatilities run about 2-3 times index levels. Implied-volatility rank is UNVERIFIED for all six names — no free IV-history source is available.

items.title: Rates: 10-year at 4.90%, curve flattening, funding calm
items.detail: FRED prints dated Nov 4, the latest available, put the effective fed funds rate at 3.88%, the 2-year at 4.58%, and the 10-year at 4.90%, a 2s10s spread of +32 basis points, flattening about 9 basis points over 60 days. SOFR at 3.92% sits 4 basis points over the effective fed funds rate, a normal overnight funding print with no stress signal. The 10-year has eased 41 basis points since its Oct 5 peak of 5.31%, which modestly relieves discount-rate pressure on growth names, but near 5% it remains a valuation headwind for long-duration exposure.

desks.Dividends: Apple goes ex-dividend Thu Nov 12 at $0.27 per quarter, unchanged; Microsoft goes ex-dividend Thu Nov 19 at $0.98, the first payment at the raised rate (+7.7% from $0.91, its 24th consecutive annual increase), payable Dec 10. Any premium or assignment analysis spanning Nov 19 should use $0.98, not the stale $0.91. Nvidia has not yet declared its December dividend. SPY and QQQ December distributions fall outside the window. Tesla pays no dividend.
desks.Earnings: Nvidia is the only watchlist name reporting in the window, Tue Nov 17 after close, with Nasdaq consensus EPS of $2.49 (13 estimates) and Q3 guidance of $108.0 billion revenue at 74.0% gross margin. The implied earnings-day move is ±6.2% (desk calc, cross-checked vs ApexVol ±6.1%), against a 10-year average realized move of ±8.4% and a 2-year average of ±5.7%. Apple reported Mon Nov 2 after close (EPS $2.10 vs $1.99 consensus, revenue $114.48 billion) with a -1.9% first-session reaction; Microsoft reported Oct 28 and Tesla reported Oct 21.
desks.Futures: Brent settled Fri at $98.32 and WTI at $90.83, down about 13% on the week — the biggest weekly percentage drop since 2022 — as the midterm result repriced Iran-war premium lower, while Hormuz tanker attacks on Nov 5-6 put a floor under the fall. EIA petroleum (week ended Oct 30): crude drew 865,000 barrels against a polled build, and distillate drew 3.6 million barrels to 99.3 million, its lowest since May 2003 and 13% below its five-year average. Brent swaps flipped to contango. Natural gas storage rose 77 billion cubic feet to 3,801 billion. Next catalysts: USDA WASDE and EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook Tue Nov 10; EIA petroleum Thu Nov 12.
desks.Parity: No published put-call or box parity violation was found for SPY or QQQ this week. S&P 500: Okta replaced Kenvue before trading opened Nov 4, a constituent swap only, with no parity implication. Nasdaq-100 annual reconstitution: ranking Mon Nov 30, announcement after close Fri Dec 11, effective open Mon Dec 21 — a watch item only, as reconstitution flows can briefly widen the index-arbitrage basis around the effective date. No new index methodology document was published this week.
desks.Premium: Live post-close implied volatility (Nov 6): SPY 0.157, QQQ 0.231, Apple 0.201, Microsoft 0.235, Nvidia 0.436, Tesla 0.424 at the Nov 9 expiry. Apple and Microsoft verdicts are WINDOW-CONTINGENT — a single day drives 55.5% and 49.9% of their 20-day realized variance. SPY is modestly above realized, QQQ at parity, Nvidia and Tesla modestly above realized. Nvidia's Nov 20 expiry implied volatility of 0.694 versus 0.572 at Nov 13 prices the Nov 17 earnings event; premium into this binary event is to be avoided. Implied-volatility rank is UNVERIFIED for all six names.
desks.Quant lab: Nineteen new candidates were added to the ledger (#214-232): seven WATCH and twelve ARCHIVE, with no TEST or INTEGRATE movement. The strongest is #216, 'OLIVIA — point-in-time protocol for LLM news readings' (score 57, WATCH), whose fine-tuned model held an information coefficient of 0.020 on a blinded Jan-Jul 2026 window; it is directly relevant to the availability-contract and frozen-referee lanes, but has no code link. #219, Lorig's derivatives lecture notes with Python code (score 57), is a reference resource, not an adoption candidate. #183's Zenodo code-and-data link is now confirmed in the arXiv record.
